Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

The triangle $△ABC$ is shown above. Which of the following is $△{A}^{′}{B}^{′}{C}^{′},$ the image of $△ABC$ under the action of $T?$

Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

The triangle $△ABC$ is shown above. Which of the following is $△{A}^{′}{B}^{′}{C}^{′},$ the image of $△ABC$ under the action of $T?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the image of $T$ under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of $△ABC:$

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & 3 \\ -2 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & 3 \\ -2 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & 2 \\ -3 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective vertices of $△{A}^{′}{B}^{′}{C}^{′}$ are $(2,-3),(-2,1),(2,3)$, as shown below.
